description: This file defines the BrowserControl class responsible for opening URLs in the user's default web browser. It provides methods to display URLs via AWT Desktop or fall back to OS-specific commands.

classes.name: BrowserControl
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to open URLs in the default web browser, with fallback mechanisms for different OS platforms.

methods.name: displayURL
methods.description: Attempts to open the provided URL in the default desktop browser using java.awt.Desktop; falls back to OS-specific command if needed.

methods.name: displayURLtraditional
methods.description: Attempts to open URL via OS-specific commands based on the platform (Windows or Unix).

methods.name: isWindowsPlatform
methods.description: Checks if the current operating system is Windows.
